recommendation: Keep this core audit commit. Future $everything wording changes should be made in HL7/admin-incubator unless PA/FHIR-I move these operations back into core.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive PA tracker requesting Encounter and EpisodeOfCare $everything to be reviewed and synchronized with Patient $everything changes from FHIR-43373 and FHIR-44604, including removal of US Core requirements, paging notes, and stale ordering guidance while retaining correct compartment references.
initial_application: Commit 8085536f12e251d00b80ac47323658eb94e9b1ac applied FHIR-43373 and FHIR-44604 to Patient/$everything. Commit e8524f5b6b54904776987148319de565a582b52d then applied FHIR-44816 to Encounter/$everything and EpisodeOfCare/$everything and cleaned a duplicated Patient footer sentence.
additional_context: In November 2025, PA moved Patient/$everything, Encounter/$everything, EpisodeOfCare/$everything, and Patient/$merge to the Admin Incubator IG. Core commit b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc removed the three $everything OperationDefinition XML files and removed their operation-list entries. Current core narrative points to the Admin Incubator pages, whose package/source contains the FHIR-44816 wording. FHIR-52121 is a later Triaged paging discussion and is not a final reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the relevant OperationDefinition sources are no longer in the current core build scope.
